species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 46°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 18–70 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 80 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 120 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
